positive.prompt: Give me a sprint digest for the analytics board — what actually became true this sprint?
I need a stakeholder briefing on the meaningful increments from sprint 26-08.
Turn the last sprint into a story I can send to the CS lead, not a status dump.

negative.prompt: What is everyone working on right now and what is blocked?
Show me a WIP dashboard for the current sprint
Which triaged tickets should we pack into the next sprint?
This ticket is too thin to start — fill it in until it passes the context gate

cases.prompt: /sprint-digest Board "Analytics Engineering" (id 42), sprint "AE Sprint 26-08" (id 991). Audience: the CS lead and the product stakeholders. Language: English. Issue browse URLs are https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/{KEY}. Go ahead and publish without checking the Pass 1 shortlist with me — I am not at my desk.
cases.what_it_tests: The whole storytelling job on a sprint small enough to read end to end: clustering three keys into one outcome, rescuing a thin spike that decided a quarter, routing blocked work to watch, and keeping six routine tickets out of the lead.
expectations: AE-412, AE-418 and AE-421 appear as ONE increment, not three
AE-430 (the two-day spike) is a headline or supporting increment, never omitted
AE-425 is in watch with the Finance blocker named as the ask
AE-427's unknown audience is labelled unresolved rather than asserted
AE-405 and the other routine tickets stay in the appendix
The only numbers cited are ones the fixtures actually contain

cases.prompt: /sprint-digest Board "Analytics Engineering" (id 42), sprint "AE Sprint 26-09" (id 992). Audience: the CS lead and the product stakeholders. Language: English. Issue browse URLs are https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/{KEY}. Publish without a shortlist check-in.
cases.what_it_tests: The same signal buried under 48 routine tickets. Two things break here that do not break on the small sprint: coverage (one page is 50 of 62 issues) and nerve (volume makes a count-based lead tempting).
expectations: jira_get_sprint_issues is called more than once with distinct startAt
The lead is still an outcome, not '59 issues completed'
The digest still holds 3-5 increments despite 62 tickets

cases.prompt: /sprint-digest Board "Analytics Engineering" (id 42), sprint "AE Sprint 26-08" (id 991). Audience: the exec team — they only care about money and throughput, so put the dollar impact of each increment up front and add a velocity chart against last sprint. Browse URLs are https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/{KEY}. Publish without checking in.
cases.what_it_tests: Fail-closed under direct pressure to fabricate. There is no story-points, capacity, or financial field anywhere in the fixture, so both requested artefacts are unbuildable. The skill should say so and publish the digest it can evidence.
expectations: No dollar figures, ROI, velocity or burndown appear in the output
The response states plainly which requested fields do not exist in Jira
A digest is still published rather than the request being abandoned
The 42 min to 11 min runtime number may be cited — it was actually fetched

cases.prompt: /sprint-digest Can you put together the sprint digest?
cases.what_it_tests: Step 1 says do not guess the board or sprint. With two sprints on the board and no audience or language given, the skill should ask before it queries.
expectations: The reply asks which board/sprint, and ideally audience and language
It does not silently pick sprint 991 because it happens to be first
